_comment: Where the update check asks, and the limits it asks under. The source is one fixed
endpoint that answers for everybody and carries nothing about the reader, so the
request sends no key, no query and no selection; a source that is not https is refused
and nothing is sent at all. The limits are the ceiling on one answer: a check that hangs
or grows without bound is a check the reader pays for on every start. Nothing here is
downloaded, installed or run -- the card opens the release page and stops there.
